## Read it free

You can read the whole book here at no cost, or
[download the free EPUB](https://github.com/bgweber/AdtechBook/releases/latest) for your e-reader. The EPUB's equations need a
reader with math (MathML) support, such as Apple Books, Thorium Reader, or
Calibre. Kindle doesn't support it and shows the equations garbled, so on
Kindle, read the chapters with equations here instead. The
[**paperback**](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HSX91M9W) is available on Amazon.
:::
:::

## How to use this book

Most chapters explain one part of a DSP and include an exercise on adsim,
the book's simulated ad market, which knows the true click, install, and lift
behind every impression. The simulator and the companion code live in the
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/bgweber/AdtechBook), and the Preface
explains which chapters have exercises and how to run them.

## Requirements

The simulator and the training examples use Python, and the reference bidder
uses Go. The quickest way to run them is Docker: `docker compose up --build`
starts the simulator, the bidder, and its console, which opens in a browser.
Every exercise, including the neural networks in Part IV, runs on a laptop's
CPU.
